dedupe_keys.name: kuro siwo multi temporal flood dataset

description: Kuro Siwo is Orion Lab's satellite-radar dataset for rapid flood mapping. It contains 43 events across six continents and three climate zones during 2015 to 2022, with expert-interpreted annotations at 10 metre resolution. Each event includes one post-flood and two pre-flood Sentinel-1 acquisitions, elevation information and water-class or validity masks. GRD and SLC variants support different radar representations. Public data are free under CC-BY-4.0, stated in the provider's Hugging Face card, and the GitHub repository supplies preprocessing and training instructions. A limitation is that selected event coverage does not constitute a continuous global flood inventory. Interpretation and acquisition timing affect labels, and the hosted preview currently reports a viewer error. The dataset can train flood detection and provide observations for evaluating infrastructure inundation models such as Delft3D FM (model-delft3d-fm). Its NeurIPS 2024 paper describes the benchmark. No imagery, annotations or model weights were downloaded.
